column1: # 50 fixed Lviv house-number probes for LvivAddressSearchTest.
# Frozen after one generation from tools/pipeline/osm-extract over the Lviv
# city bbox. Coordinates are the fixture rows the extractor wrote; a rebuild
# from the same OSM snapshot reproduces them. The set covers a letter suffix
# typed with a hyphen, with a Cyrillic letter and with a Latin letter, two
# houses on one street, and one street name in two localities.
# Columns: query, expected latitude, expected longitude
